# History

What left the roadmap, newest first: one short entry per milestone or epic that shipped, was
dropped or was superseded. The roadmap (README.md) shows where we are going from here; this file
is where finished work goes. What shipped and when is also in CHANGELOG.md, why a course changed
is in DECISIONS.md, and a finished milestone keeps its full record in its SPEC.md.

Written by `tools/docs/roadmap.py retire` and `tools/docs/roadmap.py prune`. Do not edit by hand.
